purpose: Designs document search: pre-search freshness judgment, the search result contract, the AI-readable ToC copy, and DLID resolution via recorded paths without modifying any managed state.
summary: Pre-search judgment: no confirmed ToC, rebuild not needed, rebuild needed, or undeterminable
User choice between rebuild-then-search and searching the existing version, with rebuild scale shown
Undeterminable cases are treated as failures and stop search without falling back to old version
Search result contract: document ID, recorded path, reason, section, key, version, freshness
Search AI reads all entries of the ToC copy and prioritizes avoiding missed documents
Contents of the ToC copy given to the search AI: document info and section headings, no paths
resolve-dlid resolves DLIDs from recorded paths and verifies them against actual files
Resolution outcomes: resolved, not at recorded path, no record; content hash attached when available
Search and resolution do not write to ToC, management state, or index target documents
tasks: Implementing search pre-check and freshness judgment
Implementing the search skill and search AI agent
Reviewing handling of stale or undeterminable ToC versions
title: DES-006 文書検索設計
